messages:
maria: Quick update for everyone doing the annual attestations: we're running a 48-hour sprint to tidy evidence and validate owners. Two lanes: fast uploads (no review needed) and review-required (legal/infra must sign off). Please follow the filename rubric in the checklist before upload. https://redwood.company/compliance/attest-2026/rubric :link: 

devops-lead: Heads-up: prefix infra diagrams with `INFRA_` and include the service tag, e.g. `INFRA_auth-v2_network-diagram.pdf`. That makes triage much faster. I pushed a small script to normalize names: `scripts/normalize_attest_names.sh`. :gear:

sam: Where do we stash screenshots of KMS settings? Can I put them in the shared dropbox path or do they need redaction first?

legal-sara: If screenshots contain key IDs, mask them first. If in doubt, upload to the review-required lane and tag me /legal-sara. We'll do a quick redaction pass during office hours. :white_check_mark:

attest-bot: Reminder: office hours for legal + infra triage scheduled 2026-04-02 10:00-12:00 PT. Create COM-ATT exception tickets for any artifacts you cannot upload before the snapshot. Tickets without the template will be delayed.

maria: Important: snapshot cutoff is 2026-04-02 18:00 PT. After that we snapshot the repository and send a summary to execs. If you need a short extension, open an exception ticket and include the expected completion timestamp and blocker. We'll escalate for high-severity blockers. :loudspeaker:

devops-lead: Quick note on access: if you hit a permission error use `rbac audit --user $EMAIL` and DM me. I fixed a stale group binding earlier so try again before raising a ticket.

sam: Uploaded redacted KMS screenshots to review-required lane and referenced ticket COM-ATT-5123. Thanks @legal-sara for the fast review. :pray:

maria: Thanks team. We'll post a tiny exec-ready summary after the snapshot. If you're unsure which lane to pick, default to review-required so legal can confirm.
